name: Mixed EN/JP — mild hedging, low risk deferral
transcript:
[00:00:06] Tanaka: Thank you for sharing the updated roadmap.
[00:00:12] Sam: Of course. Does the direction align with what you were expecting?
[00:00:17] Tanaka: Yes, mostly. We are still evaluating a few aspects. I think we need a bit more time to review the technical specifications.
[00:00:27] Sam: Completely understandable. Is there a specific section that needs more clarity?
[00:00:33] Tanaka: The integration section is what we want to review more carefully. 少し時間をいただけますか。来週には結論が出ると思います。
[00:00:45] Sam: Of course. Take the time you need. Is there any additional information I can provide that would help?
[00:00:52] Tanaka: A technical FAQ document would be helpful if you have one.
[00:00:57] Sam: I will send that over today. And I will check back with you next Wednesday if that works.
[00:01:04] Tanaka: Next Wednesday is fine. We should have clarity by then.
[00:01:09] Sam: Perfect. Looking forward to your thoughts.

summary: Tanaka is still evaluating the technical specifications, particularly the integration section.
A decision is expected by next week; Sam will follow up next Wednesday.
Sam will send a technical FAQ document today to support the review.
